description: Header file for OS-specific functionality in the formatting library, defining classes, macros, and functions for system error handling, file operations, and platform-specific utilities.

classes.name: basic_cstring_view
classes.description: A reference to a null-terminated string, constructible from C strings or std::string, used for wrapping C API parameters.

classes.name: buffered_file
classes.description: A class representing a buffered file stream, managing FILE* resources with RAII.

classes.name: file
classes.description: A class encapsulating file descriptor operations, supporting open, close, read, write, dup, and fdopen.

classes.name: pipe
classes.description: A structure representing a pipe with read and write ends as file objects.

classes.name: ostream
classes.description: A fast buffered output stream for writing to files, supporting formatted output and file management.

methods.name: report_windows_error
methods.description: Reports a Windows error without throwing an exception.
